body:
Fast path. Refs: ATE-441 (CI items only; the ADR text items in that issue are untouched).

## Summary

- Add the missing `# v3.2.0` comment to the `pnpm/setup` pin in `pr-metadata.yml`. The SHA `731dfb64…` is the commit of the annotated `v3.2.0` tag in `pnpm/setup` (verified through the GitHub API); the SHA is unchanged.
- Keep the full `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `fetch-depth: 0` in `pr-metadata.yml` (accepted outcome of the issue). Reasons:
  - `fetch-depth: 0` is needed on the `release: update versions` path: `validate-version-pr` runs `git diff base...head` and `merge-base --is-ancestor`, which need history of unbounded length.
  - pnpm has no lockfile-pinned subset install of one project's devDependencies; `commitlint.title.config.js` needs `@commitlint/cli` and `@commitlint/config-conventional`. `--filter .` would only skip the `blueprint` workspace, a marginal saving. A separate manifest and lockfile would add a second thing to maintain.
  - Measured cost on a recent run: whole job about 25s, install 4s, checkout 2s (pnpm store is cached through `setup-node`). Not worth the risk or maintenance.

## Evidence

- `pnpm verify`: all lanes pass (static, app-test 157 suites / 1152 tests).
- Real interface: exempt (CI only, one comment).
- Title and body checks are untouched. Locally, `commitlint --config commitlint.title.config.js` exits 0 for `ci(workflows): ok title` and 1 for `bad title`; the body step is unchanged and fails on an empty body. The `PR metadata` job on this PR runs the edited workflow.
- Test audit: no test needed; a YAML comment has no behavior and a test would be implementation-coupled.
- Branch is `ci/pr-metadata-install-cost` as assigned, not `fast/<slug>`; it is not a Change prefix, so no Change trailers apply.

## Review

Standards (with test audit) and Spec reviewers ran independently: no blocking findings. Non-blocking: the other pins use `# v3` while this one uses `# v3.2.0` (kept, the issue asks for `v3.2.0`); branch prefix noted above; Spec reviewer's wording correction (the repo is a workspace) is applied in the Summary.

## Merge Danger

None. Comment-only diff in one workflow file; no behavior, secrets or permissions change.

## 摘要

為 `pr-metadata.yml` 的 `pnpm/setup` pin 補上 `# v3.2.0` 註解（SHA 已驗證對應 v3.2.0 tag，未變動）。完整 install 與 `fetch-depth: 0` 維持不變：release 版本 PR 路徑需要完整歷史，pnpm 無法對單一專案做 lockfile 鎖定的子集安裝，且整個 job 約 25 秒（install 4 秒），不值得改。`pnpm verify` 全過；僅 CI，免真實介面驗證。

## Summary

Fast path. Two major bumps, one commit each, handled separately per `docs/maintenance-policy.md`.

```text
@hookform/resolvers   6.0.2 -> 7.0.8   (+ override key @6>ajv -> @7>ajv)
@testing-library/jest-dom 7.0.1 -> 8.0.0   (root + blueprint/)
```

**@hookform/resolvers 7.0.0 migration points**

- The only breaking change is the typebox resolver. Safe: the repo imports only `@hookform/resolvers/zod` (6 imports in `src/components`, no other subpath, no typebox reference).
- Peers: `zod ^3.25 || ^4` and `react-hook-form ^7.55`. Safe: lockfile resolves zod 4.6.7 and react-hook-form 7.92.0 in the 7.0.8 snapshot.
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` override: v7 still declares `ajv ^8.12.0` as an optional peer, and pnpm resolved it into the snapshot once the old `@6` key stopped matching. The override is kept with key `@7>ajv`; the 7.0.8 snapshot lists no `ajv` again. The comment above it stays accurate (the `ajv-formats` peer is still kept).

**@testing-library/jest-dom 8.0.0 migration points**

- The only breaking change is dropping vitest below 5. Safe: the repo uses Jest 30; vitest is an optional peer that nothing installs. Usage is only the bare `import "@testing-library/jest-dom"` in `test/setup/frontend.ts` and `blueprint/test/setup.ts`.
- Engines `node >=22`: repo pins 24.x.
- Peer `@testing-library/dom >=10 <11`: root has 10.4.2.

## Evidence

- **Before:** main, `c86e1db4b`
  **After:** `pnpm verify:all` on `cfe6c239635bdd2d3227b16785c181db45a41fc8`: static, workflow, integration, app-build, blueprint, app-test all pass (exit 0); app-test 157 suites, 1152 tests.
- No source or test file changed, so no form validation message changed. Real interface: exempt per the spec.
- Test audit: no test added, changed, deleted or moved; `test-audit` not triggered.
- Changeset: none. No user-visible behavior change (`writing-changesets`: dep upgrades with no user-visible effect are omitted); jest-dom is dev-only.

## Review

- Round 1 (whole diff against `origin/main`, head `cfe6c239635bdd2d3227b16785c181db45a41fc8`): Standards no blocking findings; Spec no findings.
- Non-blocking, dismissed: Standards noted the branch prefix `deps/` is not a `fast/<slug>` branch; the developer's task named this branch. Standards noted the evidence must appear in the PR; it is above.
- Rounds 1, rework root causes none, meaningful findings 0, review wall time and token/cost: not measured.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way (revert both commits; lockfile restores the old versions).

**Blast Radius:** forms

All six forms validate through `zodResolver`; the 7.x resolver API for Zod is unchanged and the suite passes. jest-dom affects tests only.

## 摘要

Fast path:升級兩個 major 套件,各一個 commit。`@hookform/resolvers` 6→7(僅 typebox resolver 有破壞性變更,本專案只用 Zod;override 鍵改為 `@7>ajv`),`@testing-library/jest-dom` 7→8(僅移除 vitest <5 支援,本專案用 Jest)。`pnpm verify:all` 全數通過,無原始碼或測試變更,真實介面免驗證。

**Fast path** · Refs ATE-439 (follow-ups from the ATE-423 Cycle 9 ponytail-audit and test-audit on `cec0d2910`; entry writes, ADR-0149, `useEntryRecording`). The issue description is the spec. One commit per item.

## Summary

```diff
 test/integration/persistence/game-entry-writes.itest.ts
+  it("rejects a new seq for an existing entry without touching the set or its version")
+    → rejects { reason: ENTRY_SEQ_CHANGED, httpStatus: 400 }; raw sets[0].ver and entries unchanged
 test/integration/support/seed.ts
+  readRawGame(gameId)        # replaces 3 copies in game-entry-{writes,lineups}, game-repository itests

 useEntryRecording (src/lib/features/game/hooks/use-entry-recording.ts)
   stage(content, identity, apply)
+    if (!game) return { status: "failed", error }     # was apply(game!, …) → TypeError
   record(...)
-    if (result.status === "recorded") void flush()   # enqueue sets nextAttemptAt = now; the pending-writes timer flushes
   edit(...)
-    if (result.status === "invalid") return result
+    if (result.status !== "recorded") return result
     await flush()                                     # kept: edit returns the write's result

 src/lib/api/__tests__/error-toast.test.ts
-  expect(mockToast.mock.calls[0][0].variant).toBe("error")
+  expect(mockToast.mock.calls).toEqual([[{ ...connectionError, variant: "error" }]])
```

| # | Item | Commit |
| - | ---- | ------ |
| 1 | `ENTRY_SEQ_CHANGED` proof at the repository/database boundary | `test(game): prove the repository refuses a changed entry seq untouched` |
| 2 | Drop redundant `void flush()` in `record` | `refactor(game): let the pending-writes timer flush a recorded entry` |
| 3 | `stage` guard when the game is not loaded (internal defensive guard) | `fix(game): return failed instead of throwing when recording before the game loads` |
| 4 | Toast test asserts the whole toast shown, once | `test(api): assert the toast a refresh timeout shows, not one field of the call` |

Item 3 reuses the existing `failed` result, so no caller changes: `Substitutes.onSubmit` already stops on `"failed"` and `oppo.tsx` stops on anything but `"recorded"`/`"edited"`. `oppo.tsx` is untouched (PR #756 owns it).

## Evidence

**Item 1 mutation.** The seq guard runs twice on the repository path: `planEntryUpserts` calls `assertSeqFixed`, then hands its result to `upsertEntries` → `mergeEntries`, which calls it again.

- Mutation A, delete only the `assertSeqFixed(existing, entry)` call in `planEntryUpserts`: the new itest stays **green**, because the `mergeEntries` call still rejects. This is redundant guarding, not a gap in the test (left as is; out of scope).
- Mutation B, disable the guard (`isSeqChanged` returns `false`, which removes both calls): the new itest goes **red**.

```diff
 export function isSeqChanged(existing: EntryIdentity, incoming: EntryIdentity): boolean {
-  return existing.seq !== incoming.seq;
+  return false;
 }
```

```
● identity-keyed entry writes › rejects a new seq for an existing entry without touching the set or its version
    expect(received).rejects.toMatchObject()
    Received promise resolved instead of rejected
    Resolved to value: [{ … "id": "entry-1", … "seq": 3, … }]
Tests:       1 failed, 6 passed, 7 total
```

Restored: `Tests: 7 passed, 7 total`. Mutation B was rerun on the final test after the review fixes.

**Item 2.** The existing case "returns at once with a fresh entry, shows it and queues it, then flushes in the background" still waits for the PUT and passes without the explicit flush.

**Item 3 regression.** Before the fix, the new case fails. After the fix, it passes.

```
● useEntryRecording before the game has loaded › records nothing and queues nothing instead of throwing
    TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'sets')
```

**Gates.** `pnpm verify:all` passed on the reviewed head:

```
lane        status  seconds
static      pass    41.6
integration pass    18.0
app-build   pass    25.3
app-test    pass    10.8
workflow    skip    0.0
blueprint   skip    0.0
```

**Real interface: exempt.** No user-visible behavior changes. Item 3 has no user-visible effect: the recording UI cannot be reached while the game is loading (it shows a skeleton, see the screenshot below), so the guard is an internal defensive check proven at the hook level.

**Item 3 in the real interface: what the user sees.** Answer: nothing, because the recording UI cannot be reached before the game loads.

- Callers that handle the new `failed` result:
  - `src/components/game/panel/moves/oppo.tsx:39`: `if (result.status !== "recorded") return;`. No toast.
  - `src/components/game/panel/substitutes/index.tsx:69`: `if (result.status === "failed") return;`. No toast.
  - Neither caller reads `error`, so `error === undefined` reaches no message in `src/lib/api/error-messages.ts`.
- The only route that mounts these panels with live data is `Game` (`src/components/game/index.tsx:66`). While `useGame` is loading it returns `<GameSkeleton />` instead of `GamePanel`.
  - The edit dialog (`GameOptions`) renders inside that same loaded branch.
  - The landing demo (`src/components/landing/record-demo.tsx:231`) seeds the SWR cache, so its game is always defined.
- Dev server, game `agent-test-439`, Chrome at 390×844 (touch):
  - Playwright `page.route` held `GET /api/games/:id`. The page showed only the skeleton; the only buttons were Back and the Next dev tools button, and no move buttons.
  - Tapping two skeleton move tiles produced no toast, no `pageerror` and no console error.
  - After the response was released, the move panel rendered normally.
- The guard is therefore defensive: in today's UI it is reached only through the hook, which the unit test `useEntryRecording before the game has loaded › records nothing and queues nothing instead of throwing` covers.

![Held GET: skeleton, no toast; released: move panel](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad9106e1-d385-4516-b1fe-94294d0ff713)

**Knowledge.** Assessed `blueprint/content/features/game-recording/{rally-recording,persistence}`. No change needed: neither page describes the immediate flush after `record` or behavior before the game loads, and the persistence page's seq-immutability statement (ADR-0149) is unchanged.

**Changeset.** None. Items 1 and 4 are test-only, item 2 preserves behavior, and item 3 has no user-visible effect, so a release note would mislead. No PR check requires a changeset: `.github/workflows/changesets.yml` runs only on push to `main`.

## Review

- **Reviewed head:** `d21389929`. **Base:** `origin/main` `c86e1db4b`.
- **Final head:** `10287edea`. It merges `origin/main` twice: `a35997dbe` (#761, dependency upgrades) and `37b397f51` (#760, a CI workflow label). Main changed none of this PR's files and neither merge had conflicts. It also removes the item-3 changeset at the developer's decision. Under the re-review table, none of these needs re-review: the merges are conflict-free and the removal is a metadata file. `pnpm verify` passes.
- **Round 1, whole diff, two separate fresh reviewers.**
  - **Spec:** PASS, no findings. Notes: explain mutation A against mutation B, and word the real-interface exemption. Both are done above.
  - **Standards:** 1 hard finding and 4 judgement calls.
    - Hard, accepted and fixed: the raw `games` read was copied into a second itest. docs/testing-strategy.md Test Support Code says "never copy it", so it moved into `readRawGame`.
    - Judgement, accepted: the commit subject overstated the check as "at the database". Reworded.
    - Judgement, accepted: the connection-error literal was repeated in `error-toast.test.ts`. It is now one const.
    - Judgement, dismissed: the name `WriteFailed` also covers "not loaded". It is the existing status every caller already stops on.
    - Judgement, dismissed: a `deferred` is created on every `renderRecording` call. Minor.
  - **Test audit:** pass with notes. The itest partly overlaps the entity test, but it adds the no-write storage check (`ver` and entries unchanged), so it is kept.
- **Round 2, delta, one fresh reviewer, separate Standards and Spec sections.**
  - **Spec:** PASS.
  - **Standards:** 1 blocking finding. A third copy of the raw read was left in `game-repository.itest.ts`. The round specified the fix verbatim, so the root session applied it and, per the re-review table, no further round was needed.
  - **Test audit:** PASS.
- **Fixed point:** both axes have no unresolved blocking findings.
- **Metrics:**
  - Rounds: 2.
  - Meaningful findings: 3 fixed.
  - Rework root cause: one test helper copy, not fully consolidated in the first fix.
  - Review wall time: about 3 minutes of reviewer time.
  - Token and cost: unknown.
  - Human active minutes: unknown.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** small

The only production change is in `useEntryRecording`: one guard, and one removed redundant flush call. The rest is tests. Reverting is a plain revert.

## 摘要

Fast path 處理 ATE-439 的 4 個 audit 後續項目，每項一個 commit：

1. 新增 itest，證明 repository 會拒絕改了 seq 的 entry write。拒絕時回 400 `ENTRY_SEQ_CHANGED`，set 內容和 `ver` 都不變。mutation B 會讓測試轉紅。
2. 刪掉 `record` 裡多餘的 `void flush()`。
3. 比賽資料還沒載入時，`stage` 改回傳 `failed`，不再丟出 TypeError。附 regression test。此 guard 屬內部防禦，使用者看不到，故不附 changeset。
4. toast 測試改為驗證完整的 toast 內容，不再只檢查呼叫參數裡的單一欄位。

真實介面驗證豁免，因為使用者看不到任何行為差異。

## Summary

Fast path (ATE-446). In dialogs whose title holds a back button (rally edit 編輯逐球紀錄 and match info edit 編輯賽事資訊), the back button and title sat 8px below the close button. `DialogHeader` pushed its content down by `(control-size - 1.25rem) / 2` to centre a 20px text title on the close button; a title that already contains a control-size back button was pushed twice. The title row now takes the control height (`min-h-(--control-size)`) instead of the column being padded, so a text title, a back button and the close button share one vertical centre. No new prop or slot, no change to `options/edit/index.tsx` or `options/index.tsx`.

The only other dialog with a back button in its header is the match info edit view in `game/new`; `EditDialogContainer` and the remaining dialogs have plain titles and are unchanged in position. The overlays Blueprint page described the old negative-margin mechanism and is updated. `forms/index.mdx` and ADR-0131/0132 make no header-alignment claim, so they need no change.

## Evidence

Measured in Chrome against a local dev server (test game `agent-test-446`), centre-y of back button / title text / close button:

| Dialog | Width | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rally edit | 390 | 94 / 94 / 86 | 86 / 86 / 86 |
| Rally edit | 1280 | 94 / 94 / 86 | 86 / 86 / 86 |
| Match info edit | 390 | 94 / 94 / 86 | 86 / 86 / 86 |
| Match info edit | 1280 | 94 / 94 / 86 | 86 / 86 / 86 |

An agent that did not write the change re-measured all of the above plus the plain-title dialogs (new match, options): title and close button both at 86, no overlap or clipping.

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rally edit 390 | ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4dc06dab-b785-40c0-b8c7-65d507771a06) | ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f7058425-a9da-4173-8d3a-06190b96805f) |
| Rally edit 1280 | ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3c97b337-957d-4e24-873e-7a86423c05ff) | ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1d9282c4-b09c-456a-ae32-531b16a6b3f3) |
| Match info edit 390 | ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d38e0751-5056-4e1a-b940-267621fa7293) | ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1a2736f5-138e-4dfd-bb35-ba8eec445579) |
| Match info edit 1280 | ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5763aece-707a-4b7d-94a3-cb59f940a4ff) | ![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5b27940f-0eee-46af-9186-32a49481c5a1) |

`pnpm verify` and `pnpm verify:all` pass. No test added: the fix is a class change with no new logic.

## Review

- Standards (with test audit): pass, no hard violations. Test audit: no test added, changed or deleted; none needed. One judgement call, changeset wording, applied.
- Spec: pass. One blocking finding (overlays Blueprint page described the old mechanism) fixed in the second commit. Noted, not changed: plain-text-title dialogs grow 8px (12px on touch) because the title row is now control-height, so their descriptions and bodies shift down by that much; a `DialogTitle` that is not a direct child of the header column is not covered (none exist).
- Knowledge: `overlays/index.mdx` updated; `forms/index.mdx` unchanged (no header-alignment rule).

## Merge Danger

Low. One shared class touches every `DialogHeader` with a close or expand button, shifting description and body 8px down (12px on touch) in plain-title dialogs. Merge conflicts with #756 are unlikely: it edits `options/edit/index.tsx` and `options/index.tsx`, which this PR does not touch.

## 摘要

修正「編輯逐球紀錄」「編輯賽事資訊」dialog 中返回鈕與標題比關閉鈕低 8px 的問題。成因是 `DialogHeader` 以固定 padding 置中 20px 文字標題，內含返回鈕的標題被重複位移。改為讓標題列等於 control 高度，返回鈕、標題、關閉鈕共用同一垂直中心；不新增 prop。純文字標題的 dialog 內文會整體下移 8px（觸控裝置 12px）。390px／1280px 前後截圖與量測見 Evidence，`pnpm verify`、`pnpm verify:all` 通過。

## Summary

Fast path for ATE-426 (bug). The intercepted 建立球隊 dialog that the in-app 建立隊伍 link opens kept its own copy of the team-creation submit. When the device-local active team arrived, only the full-page `NewTeamWorkspace` started writing the preference. Neither path refetched the user's players list, which `useActiveTeamId` falls back to and the team switcher lists.

```diff
 (tabs)/@modal/(...)team/new/page.tsx
   <EditDialogContainer title="建立球隊">
-    <TeamForm onSubmit={POST /api/teams → cache team → replace}/>   # no preference write
+    <NewTeamWorkspace onStateChange={setIsDirty}/>

 NewTeamWorkspace.onSubmit  (src/components/team/form.tsx)
   POST /api/teams
   cache /api/teams/{id}
   save active-team preference {userId, teamId}
+  revalidate userPlayersKey(userId)        # src/hooks/use-data.ts
   replace /team/{id}?tab=about
```

Root cause:
- After creating from the dialog, a new account has no preference and a cached empty players list (`dedupingInterval` 2 min), so `resolveActiveTeam` yields `undefined`. The 球隊 tab root then falls back to `/team` (the static guide), and 新增賽事 stays disabled.
- A user who already has teams keeps the old first team active, and the switcher does not list the new team.
- Which team becomes active was already decided by the device-local active team change: creating a team writes it as the preference.

## Evidence

All screenshots are at 390px and come from a real dev server with the signed-in agent session.

Sign-in is social-only, so I could not create a brand-new account. For the new-account case the Playwright run answered `GET /api/users/*/players` with `[]` until just before submit, which simulates a new account's cached empty list. After that point every request went to the real server.

- **Before** (`origin/main` 39468f82a, dialog flow, simulated new account):
  - No preference written.
  - 新增賽事 disabled.
  - 球隊 tab → `/team` guide.
  - Same flow without the stub (real account that already has teams): the preference stored the old first team, and the 球隊 tab went to the old team.

  ![before: 球隊 tab shows the guide](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e0e43548-e5d7-4d8a-abdd-904c5afaced4) ![before: home, 新增賽事 disabled](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3bb4be6b-390c-42d5-8c3e-c257582dbccd)

- **After** (fixed head, checked by an independent agent that did not write the change):
  - Simulated new account: the preference is the new team, the 球隊 tab lands on `/team/<new id>`, and 新增賽事 is enabled on home without opening the team page.
  - Real account: the preference and the 球隊 tab move to the new team, and the switcher lists it with the existing teams.
  - No console errors.
  - Result: PASS.

  ![after: 球隊 tab opens the new team](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0e4cc86e-4d41-4c91-b119-12f9985c3e55) ![after: home, 新增賽事 enabled](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/197100e8-2bd5-409b-b8c0-5c8b600db2f1)

- **Regression test:** `src/app/(tabs)/@modal/(...)team/new/__tests__/page.test.tsx`
  - New account → 新增賽事 enabled.
  - Member of another team → the new team becomes active and the switcher lists both teams.
  - Mutation results:

    | Change applied                        | Result |
    | ------------------------------------- | ------ |
    | Restore the `origin/main` modal        | 2 red  |
    | Remove the preference write            | 1 red  |
    | Remove the players revalidation        | 1 red  |
    | None (fixed head)                      | 4/4 green |

- **Gates:** `pnpm verify:all` and `pnpm verify` exit 0 on the reviewed head.
  - An intermediate head failed random suites with SWR's `reading 'visibilityState'`. This was a pending `/api/users` request from the form test's render-only case, which is now removed.
  - `origin/main` showed 0 failures in 8 full runs. After the fix, 11 of 12 full runs passed; the 12th was a landing-test timeout under load, which passes when run alone.
- **Knowledge:** `blueprint/content/features/team-management/membership` already states "creating a team … write[s] the preference". The fix makes that true for the dialog path, so no page changes.

## Review

Pre-PR review ran three rounds, each with a Standards and a Spec reviewer in fresh contexts.
- Base: `origin/main` 39468f82a.
- Reviewed head: e4a01bfc3.
- Wall time, tokens/cost and human active minutes: unknown.

**Round 1 (whole diff)**
- Standards:
  - Blocking, fixed in 9fee4a182:
    - A deleted test had no keeper: removing the preference write left the suite green, because one team resolves the same id through the fallback.
    - The older dialog tests sent `GET /api/users` with no handler.
  - Accepted and fixed:
    - The players key was duplicated; it is now `userPlayersKey`.
    - A test read the hook's id; assertions are now on visible UI.
    - The changeset named the dialog wrongly.
  - Not blocking: `user` undefined at submit skips both writes. Recorded as a residual risk.
- Spec: PASS.

**Round 2 (delta)**
- Standards: PASS, with one note: the new-account case is turned red only by restoring the old dialog, not by a single-line mutation. Dismissed: it is the issue's reported scenario and the only 新增賽事 assertion.
- Spec: PASS.

**Round 3 (delta e4a01bfc3: removed the render-only form test; its keeper is the dialog tests)**
- Standards: PASS.
- Spec: PASS.

**Root cause behind the rework:** the regression first used a single team, which cannot tell the preference from the fallback.

**Test audit:** PASS. Two tests were deleted from `form.test.tsx`:
- "makes the created team this device's active team" → keeper is the dialog test "makes the created team the active one…".
- "renders the team creation form" → keeper is the dialog tests that find and submit the same form.

**Developer decision at G2:** typing `/team` directly still shows the guide to users who have teams. That page is static on `main`, and the 球隊 tab routes to `/team/<active team>`. I read the acceptance "`/team` lists it" as "the 球隊 tab lands on the team and the switcher lists it". Redirecting the bare URL would be new behaviour, so it is not in this PR.

**Residual risks:**
- If `useUser` has not resolved when the form is submitted, the preference write is skipped (already the case on `main`) and so is the players revalidation (new). Low risk, since the dialog is reached from signed-in screens.
- `(workspace)/team/new` (the direct full page) has no render test of its own; it renders the same `NewTeamWorkspace`.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. Client-only change; revert restores the previous behaviour, and no data or schema changes.

## 摘要

修正 app 內「建立球隊」dialog 建隊後未設為使用中球隊的問題。原本新帳號建隊後，球隊 tab 回到歡迎畫面、「新增賽事」維持 disabled；已有隊伍的使用者則仍停在舊隊，switcher 也看不到新隊。dialog 現在改用共用的 `NewTeamWorkspace`：建隊後寫入裝置的 active team preference，並重新取得使用者的 players。新帳號情境以 stub 空清單模擬（只能 social 登入，無法建新帳號）。直接輸入 `/team` 網址仍會顯示歡迎畫面，是否要導向留給開發者在 G2 決定。

## Summary

Tapping an entry in a finished set's record on `/game/[id]/sets` opened the entry editor, whose `GamePreview` reads `PendingWritesContext`, and the page crashed. `SetsList` owns the selected `setIndex` that `usePendingWrites` needs, so it now provides the context, the same way `Game` does. A route layout cannot supply it because it has no `setIndex`.

The page opens fine; the throw happens on the edit path (`preview.tsx:204`, via `EntriesEdit`). The page is reachable from the "賽事記錄" link in the game overview banner.
